ref_date_note: Mon after Aug OPEX; ESU5/NQU5 (Sep contract), no roll mention. Trades from the 'Specific Trades:' section (ES:/NQ: subsections). ES trades graded; all NQ trades ungraded (tag ''). Friday's low not given numerically -> FRI_LOW. es1 target 'bottom of Friday's range' -> FRI_LOW; its downgrade condition (LBAF of Friday's low in effect) kept in quote/stop_hint. es2 (breakdown short if 6460-6463 rejected from below) has no stated target -> first Trading Lower level 6431-6435. es3 'A+' LBAF of Friday's low: TP at 6483-6486, runners to 6496-6498 / new highs. es4 (direct long 6431-6435, 6440-6443 = proxy for 8/12 IB high 6439.75) has no stated target -> 6460-6463 (the reclaim he wants, from the preceding paragraph) then 6483-6486 (Trading Higher). Skipped as non-specific: 'buy a level directly between 6430 and 6460 ... any kind of intraday long setup (e.g. LBAF of the IB low)', quicker TP until 60-63 reclaimed. nq1 failed reclaim of 869-885 has no NQ target; he says NQ trades are 'effectively the same' as ES -> FRI_LOW (like es1). nq3 (longs on sellers failing through 764-785) no stated target -> 23831 then 869-885 (same as nq2's targets).

trades.name: Fail/LAAF of 6483-6486 (failed reclaim)
trades.quote: If we trade higher first and fail to reclaim 6483-6486, (fail or LAAF) then I will consider a short back down toward the bottom of Friday’s range and monitor for continuation. Because this has POTENTIAL for a downside break of the 3-day balance, I’ll rate it higher than I normally would given bullish context. I’ll rate it a B/B+. This trade requires a significant downgrade if we have a LBAF of Friday’s low in effect (especially if it takes place during RTH).
trades.stop_hint: This trade requires a significant downgrade if we have a LBAF of Friday’s low in effect (especially if it takes place during RTH).

trades.name: Breakdown short on rejection of 6460-6463 from below
trades.quote: If NQ remains weak and ES consolidates in the lower portion of Friday’s range, I will CONSIDER a breakdown short if 6460-6463 is rejected from below. I hate breakdown shorts but given we saw exactly this play out on NQ I’ll rate the trade a B-.

trades.name: LBAF of Friday's low
trades.quote: We already discussed the LBAF of Fridays low (regardless of where it comes from) as an A+ trade setup. I will take profit if sellers defend 6483-6486. If it is reclaimed (absent a failed reclaim), then runners broadly target new highs with 6496-6498 a take profit consideration as it is effective top of range.

trades.name: Direct long of 6431-6435 on deeper test below 6460-6463
trades.quote: If I am to directly long a deeper test below 6460-6463, I like the 6431-6435 the most.

trades.name: Failed reclaim of 23869-23885
trades.quote: A failed reclaim of 869-885 is a short. Like for ES, I am less likely to take this if a LBAF of Friday’s low is active.
trades.stop_hint: I am less likely to take this if a LBAF of Friday’s low is active.

trades.name: LBAF of Friday's low
trades.quote: A LBAF of Friday’s low is a long on NQ, careful to make sure that 764-785 is reclaimed. I would be targeting 831 then 869-885
trades.stop_hint: careful to make sure that 764-785 is reclaimed.

trades.name: Long sellers' failure to get through 23764-23785
trades.quote: Given Friday’s decent low (and its location) it is also reasonable to consider longs on any failure from sellers to get through 764-785.

trades.name: LAAF of 23831
trades.quote: The only trade I’ll add for NQ that isn’t structurally the same as for ES is that any kind of LAAF of 831 targets 764-785 with potential for runners if sellers find continuation through Friday’s low.
